install: claude mcp add --scope project --transport http atlassian https://mcp.atlassian.com/v2/mcp
verify: In Claude Code run /mcp and authenticate the atlassian server, then ask: list the tools you can call, and fetch one issue key I give you (read only).
read_only_mitigation: The documentation read does not describe a read-only mode: connect with an account or service account that has view-only project permissions, and allow only read tools by exact name after reviewing the tool list.
